truth_policy.rule: Only retained static or runtime evidence may promote a research gate. Screenshot similarity or source inference alone does not prove the native JPEG pipeline.
truth_policy.completion: The native JPEG algorithm may be called characterized only when every required gate is PASS and all unknown components are explicitly resolved or bounded.
